messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"APMO","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"APMO","units":[{"chapter":4,"text":"And after this, Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare Seth. And Adam said to Eve: 'See! we have","source_ref":"4:1"},{"chapter":4,"text":"begotten a son in place of Abel, whom Cain slew, let us give glory and sacrifice to God.'","source_ref":"4:2"},{"chapter":5,"text":"And Adam begat thirty sons and thirty daughters and Adam lived nine hundred and thirty years; and he fell sick and cried with a loud","source_ref":"5:1"},{"chapter":5,"text":"voice and said, 'Let all my sons come to me that I may see them before I die.'","source_ref":"5:2"},{"chapter":5,"text":"And all assembled, for the earth was divided into three parts. And Seth his son said to him:","source_ref":"5:3"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 4:1, 4:2, 5:1, 5:2, 5:3.
